Identification_Area.title: MARS SCIENCE LABORATORY ROVER ENVIRONMENTAL MONITORING STATION

Modification_Detail.description: This label was modified to convert to PDS4.

Field_Character.name: TIMESTAMP
Field_Character.description: Number of seconds since noon 1-Jan-2000

Field_Character.name: LMST
Field_Character.description: Local Mean Solar Time. It is in the format SSSSSMHH:MM:SS.sss where: SS - Sol number (00000-99999) M - sol/time separator HH - hour (0-23) MM - minute (0-59) SS - second (0-59) sss - fractions of second (000-999)

Field_Character.name: LTST
Field_Character.description: Local True Solar Time with respect to the rover position. It is in the format SSSSS HH:MM:SS.sss where: SS - Sol number (00000-99999) HH - hour (0-23) MM - minute (0-59) SS - second (0-59)

Field_Character.name: HORIZONTAL_WIND_SPEED
Field_Character.description: The horizontal wind direction refers to the local incoming direction of wind and it is defined clockwise w.r.t. North

Field_Character.name: VERTICAL_WIND_SPEED
Field_Character.description: The vertical wind speed, is the wind speed along the vector defined by the local gravity

Field_Character.name: WIND_DIRECTION
Field_Character.description: The wind direction refers to the local incoming direction of wind and it is defined clockwise w.r.t. North

Field_Character.name: WS_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL
Field_Character.description: String representing the confidence level for the wind sensor; 0 = bad; 1 = good; X = unknown; (byte 0 is on the left end) - Byte 0: ASIC temperature; 0 = less than -50C; 1 = more than -50C; - Byte 1: ASIC noise; 0 = electronic noise (warning); 1 = no electronic noise; - Byte 2: Rover movement; 0 = moving; 1 = still; - Byte 3: Wind Sensor correctly configured based on air temperature; 0 = wrong configuration; 1 = good configuration; - Byte 4: Wind direction; 0 = rear wind; 1 = front wind; - Byte 5: Wind observation reliability; 0 = preliminary; 1 = reliable;

Field_Character.name: BRIGHTNESS_TEMP
Field_Character.description: Brightness temperature

Field_Character.name: BRIGHTNESS_TEMP_LONG_TERM_UNCERTAINTY
Field_Character.description: Absolute systematic uncertainty of the brightness temperature

Field_Character.name: BRIGHTNESS_TEMP_SHORT_TERM_UNCERTAINTY
Field_Character.description: Relative systematic uncertainty of the brightness temperature

Field_Character.name: GTS_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL
Field_Character.description: String representing the GTS confidence level; 0 = bad; 1 = good; X = unknown; (byte 0 is on the left end) - Byte 0: ASIC power supply range; 0 = out of range; 1 = in range (V = [4.87 - 4.97]); - Byte 1: GTS recalibration quality; 0 = low quality; 1 = high quality; - Byte 2: Rover movement; 0 = moving; 1 = still; - Byte 3: Shadow in GTS Field of View 0 = full or partial shadow; 1 = no shadow;

Field_Character.name: BOOM1_LOCAL_AIR_TEMP
Field_Character.description: Local temperature for boom 1

Field_Character.name: ATS_BOOM1_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL
Field_Character.description: String representing the boom 1 ATS confidence level; 0 = bad; 1 = good; X = unknown; (byte 0 is on the left end) - Byte 0: ASIC temperature; 0 = less than -50C; 1 = more than -50C; - Byte 1: Wind Sensor status; 0 = WS off; 1 = WS on; - Byte 2: ASIC power supply range; 0 = out of range; 1 = in range (valid ranges: [4.71 - 4.79], [4.82 - 4.98], [5.11 - 5.19]); - Byte 3: Wind speed; 0 = wind speed > TBD; 1 = wind speed < TBD; - Byte 4: Wind direction with respect to each boom; 0 = from RTG or rover desk; 1 = free to rover perturbation; - Byte 5: Shadow; 0 = no shadow or partial shadow in tip or intermediate sensors; 1 = total shadow in both sensors or at night; - Byte 6: Boom in shadow; 0 = no shadow or partial shadow; 1 = total shadow or at night; - Byte 7: Observation reliability; 0 = unreliable; 1 = reliable;

Field_Character.name: BOOM2_LOCAL_AIR_TEMP
Field_Character.description: Local temperature for boom 2

Field_Character.name: ATS_BOOM2_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL
Field_Character.description: String representing the boom 2 ATS confidence level; 0 = bad; 1 = good; X = unknown; (byte 0 is on the left end) - Byte 0: ASIC temperature; 0 = less than -50C; 1 = more than -50C; - Byte 1: Wind Sensor status; 0 = WS off; 1 = WS on; - Byte 2: ASIC power supply range; 0 = out of range; 1 = in range (valid ranges: [4.71 - 4.79], [4.82 - 4.98], [5.11 - 5.19]); - Byte 3: Wind speed; 0 = wind speed > TBD; 1 = wind speed < TBD; - Byte 4: Wind direction with respect to each boom; 0 = from RTG or rover desk; 1 = free to rover perturbation; - Byte 5: Shadow; 0 = no shadow or partial shadow in tip or intermediate sensors; 1 = total shadow in both sensors or at night; - Byte 6: Boom in shadow; 0 = no shadow or partial shadow; 1 = total shadow or at night; - Byte 7: Observation reliability; 0 = unreliable; 1 = reliable;

Field_Character.name: AMBIENT_TEMP
Field_Character.description: Estimated ambient air temperature

Field_Character.name: AMBIENT_TEMP_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL
Field_Character.description: String representing the ambient temperature confidence level; 0 = bad; 1 = good; X = unknown; (byte 0 is on the left end) - Byte 0: ASIC temperature; 0 = less than -50C; 1 = more than -50C; - Byte 1: Wind Sensor status; 0 = WS off; 1 = WS on; - Byte 2: ASIC power supply range; 0 = out of range; 1 = in range (valid ranges: [4.71 - 4.79], [4.82 - 4.98], [5.11 - 5.19]); - Byte 3: Wind speed; 0 = wind speed > TBD; 1 = wind speed < TBD; - Byte 4: Wind direction with respect to each boom; 0 = from RTG or rover desk; 1 = free to rover perturbation; - Byte 5: Shadow; 0 = no shadow or partial shadow; 1 = total shadow or at night; - Byte 6: Boom in shadow; 0 = no shadow or partial shadow; 1 = total shadow or at night; - Byte 7: Operational range (error < 5 kelvin); 0 = error higher than operational range; 1 = error in operational range; - Byte 8: Observation reliability; 0 = unreliable; 1 = reliable;

Field_Character.name: UV_A
Field_Character.description: Ultraviolet radiation in band A

Field_Character.name: UV_B
Field_Character.description: Ultraviolet radiation in band B

Field_Character.name: UV_C
Field_Character.description: Ultraviolet radiation in band C

Field_Character.name: UV_ABC
Field_Character.description: Ultraviolet radiation in band ABC

Field_Character.name: UV_D
Field_Character.description: Ultraviolet radiation in band D

Field_Character.name: UV_E
Field_Character.description: Ultraviolet radiation in band E

Field_Character.name: UV_A_UNCERTAINTY
Field_Character.description: Systematic uncertainty in the ultraviolet radiation band A

Field_Character.name: UV_B_UNCERTAINTY
Field_Character.description: Systematic uncertainty in the ultraviolet radiation band B

Field_Character.name: UV_C_UNCERTAINTY
Field_Character.description: Systematic uncertainty in the ultraviolet radiation band C

Field_Character.name: UV_ABC_UNCERTAINTY
Field_Character.description: Systematic uncertainty in the ultraviolet radiation band ABC

Field_Character.name: UV_D_UNCERTAINTY
Field_Character.description: Systematic uncertainty in the ultraviolet radiation band D

Field_Character.name: UV_E_UNCERTAINTY
Field_Character.description: Systematic uncertainty in the ultraviolet radiation band E

Field_Character.name: UVS_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL
Field_Character.description: String representing the confidence level for the ultraviolet sensor; 0 = bad; 1 = good; X = unknown; (byte 0 is on the left end) - Byte 0: Global irradiance; 0 = no global irradiance; 1 = global irradiance (SZA in (0,30)); - Byte 1: Diffuse irradiance; 0 = no diffuse irradiance; 1 = diffuse irradiance (SZA in (30,inf)); - Byte 2: Arm position; 0 = unstowed; 1 = stowed; - Byte 3: Shadow; 0 = partial or total shadow; 1 = no shadow; - Byte 4: Dust sensor degradation; 0 = attenuation by dust unknown or attenuation above 10%; 1 = attenuation by dust below 10%

Field_Character.name: LOCAL_RELATIVE_HUMIDITY
Field_Character.description: Local relative humidity at humidity sensor

Field_Character.name: HS_TEMP
Field_Character.description: Humidity sensor operating temperature at the time of data collection

Field_Character.name: VOLUME_MIXING_RATIO
Field_Character.description: Volume mixing ratio

Field_Character.name: VOLUME_MIXING_RATIO_UNCERTAINTY
Field_Character.description: Uncertainty for the volume mixing ratio.

Field_Character.name: HS_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL
Field_Character.description: String representing the confidence level for the humidity; 0 = bad; 1 = good; X = unknown; (byte 0 is on the left end) - Byte 0: Humidity observation reliability; 0 = preliminary; 1 = reliable; - Byte 1: Relative humidity quality; 0 = bad; 1 = good; - Byte 2: Obtained H2O volume mixing ratio in range (ppm < 400); 0 = out of range; 1 = in range;

Field_Character.name: PS_CONFIGURATION
Field_Character.description: Pressure sensor configuration. First character: '1' = oscillator 1 on '2' = oscillator 2 on Second character: 'L' = low resolution 'H' = high resolution

Field_Character.name: PRESSURE
Field_Character.description: Pressure

Field_Character.name: PRESSURE_UNCERTAINTY
Field_Character.description: Pressure absolute accuracy

Field_Character.name: PS_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL
Field_Character.description: String representing the confidence level for the pressure sensor; 0 = bad; 1 = good; X = unknown; (byte 0 is on the left end) - Byte 0: Oscillator; 0 = oscillator 1; 1 = oscillator 2; - Byte 1: Shadow effect; 0 = shadow effect; 1 = no shadow effect;
